item.title: Final program is out!
item.description:
The European Drupal event you cannot afford to miss: the Drupal Developer Days Barcelona, is only one month away.

Another great news are a definite final program and a decision (finally) about our scholarships.

Program finished

We would like to thank everybody for submitting 34 amazing session proposals. Although we had a difficult time choosing the sessions, the great proposals made it easy to come up with a program bursting with all that is hot and happening in the Drupal universe.
Checkout the 34 sessions that made it to the final program. Besides sessions, you will be able to attend sprints and of course, there will be enough room for BOFs too.
Inaugural event is an Open Space activity on Friday at 4pm, find more details in here.

Scholarship program

Our scholarship program provides financial support for Drupal developers, who would otherwise not be able to attend, so that they can participate in the Drupal Developer Days.

We are very happy to announce the names of the five attendees that will receive these scholarships.

Sponsors

We like to thank our gold sponsors Node One and Omega8.cc for making this event possible.

Do like them and help us rock Barcelona by becoming sponsor of the Drupal Developer Days Barcelona. Find the details of the different sponsorship levels and the great companies that already have confirmed their support on the website.

Register now!

We have over 150 registered attendees now so there is plenty of room for more. For a modest 25 EUR entrance fee we serve you an action packed program as well as coffee & biscuits.

If you already pre-registered please sign in and complete the payment process.

If you have any questions, please use our forum, contact form or ping @drupaldaysbcn on Twitter.

item.title: Session voting starts
item.description:
The Drupal Developer Days in Barcelona are approaching rapidly. We'd like to take this opportunity to thank you for attending, as well as ask for your help to make this event even better. Below are some important notes regarding this event that we want you to be aware of.

Session voting starts

The deadline for session proposals has passed. We would like to thank all the submitters for very interesting session proposals.

It is now possible to vote for these sessions on the website. Voting will be possible until May 16.

Sponsors

We are still looking for companies and individuals that can sponsor our event. Please consider becoming a sponsor or make potential sponsor aware of the possibility. Find the sponsors page details of the different sponsorship levels and the great companies that already have confirmed their support on the website.

Volunteers

You can also support the event by becoming a volunteer. We need some now and many more during the event days themselves. If you want to help organizing the event onsite or online, please don't hesitate in dropping us a line.

Scholarships

The deadline to apply for scholarships for Drupal Developer Days has also passed. We will contact the people that we grant the scholarship as soon as possible.

Coders lounge / Dev Den

We're very happy to announce that we will have a coders lounge for you to use 24h during the event in the very same venue starting friday afternoon. More details on the Dev Den page.

item.title: Deadlines, sponsors & volunteers
item.description:
As the Drupal Developer Days in Barcelona getting closer, we are nearing some deadlines that you might want to know about.

Sessions

We have a bunch of excellent session proposals that have already been submitted so far, but there is still plenty of room for more.

The deadline for session proposals is April 30, 2012, so you have only a few days left to submit one. Do this via the add session page (make sure you are logged in). We are looking forward to your proposal (check the guidelines for session proposals.

Scholarships

The deadline to apply for scholarships for Drupal Developer Days in Barcelona is also next monday. Anyone who has not yet applied can do so online until April 30, 2012.

Our scholarship program provides financial support for Drupal developers, who would otherwise not be able to attend, so that they can participate in the Drupal Developer Days.
We provide this financial help to five participants.

Sponsors

We are still looking for companies and individuals that can sponsor the second edition of the European Drupal Developer Days that takes place on 15-17 June 2012 in Barcelona.

The event is the perfect opportunity to expose yourself to a technical minded audience and to show that you have a Druplicon-shaped heart.

Find the details of the different sponsorship levels on the website and the great companies that already have confirmed their love to the event are on the sponsors page.

If you want to become a sponsor or have more questions, contact us at hola[at]drupal.cat or use the contact form.

Volunteers

If you want to help organizing the event onsite or online, please don't hesitate in dropping us a line.

item.title: Registration is now open
item.description:
You can now buy your ticket for the Drupal Developer Days.

This event offers you sessions, trainings, ad-hoc meetings, code sprints and practical workshops about the latest developments and techniques in the world of Drupal.

For this three-day event we charge you a modest 25 EUR entrance fee which includes coffee & something to eat.

Please consider donating a little extra by becoming an individual sponsors. The 100 EUR individual sponsorship fee buys you a ticket, a nice t-shirt, a mentioning on the website and, most importantly, our eternal gratitude ;).

If you already pre-registered please sign in and complete the payment process.

We're also doing a scholarship program for those community members unable to attend Drupal developer days without assistance.

item.title: Drupal Developer Days Barcelona 2012
item.description:
Drupal Developer Days Barcelona 2012
We are thrilled to announce that the 2012 Drupal Developer Days will take place in Barcelona from Friday, June 15, to Sunday, June 17, 2012.

We welcome all European Drupal developers (and of course all others) to help us rock Barcelona during three exciting conference days.

During the Drupal Developer Days you can expect sessions, trainings, ad-hoc meetings, code sprints and practical workshops about the latest developments and techniques in Drupal 8 and beyond.

The conference is targeted at Drupal developers with varying skills sets: from the beginners who just discovered Drupal to the experts that push the Certified to Rock meter into the red. The sessions will focus on technical topics.

Programme

On Friday you can participate in code sprints and trainings, so you are well prepared for a long Saturday filled to the brim full with sessions. Saturday night you can re-charge your batteries and socialize during the Drupal Fiesta. But don't party too hard because we need you back on Sunday morning for more interesting sessions. We stop early on Sunday so everyone can travel home safely or enjoy a well deserved siesta.

Drupal 8 initiative sprints

Before the conference, a four day i18n sprint is being organized by Gábor Hojtsy at the same venue. During this sprint the i18n team improves and creates the multilingual features of Drupal 8. We are trying to have more core initiative sprints during the event.

Location

This three day developers gathering takes place at the Citilab grounds in Cornella de Llobregat, Barcelona. The Citilab training & research center is becoming a familiar home for Drupalistas after having hosted the 2007 Drupalcon and the 2010 Drupalcamp Spain.

Registration for the event will open very soon. A call to submit sessions will be launched after that.

The event is organized by the Catalan Drupal Association and the Spanish Drupal Association.

The Drupal Developer Days are an initiative of the Drupal community to celebrate conferences that focus on a particular aspect of web development. Check out other such initiatives like Frontend United (for designers and themers) and Drupal Business Days.

Our Drupal Developer Days website is under heavy construction but you can stay in touch by following @drupaldaysbcn on Twitter.
